Name: Fire Emblem Style Character Portraits
Author: AvianRPG
Description:
I have been a Fire Emblem fan for a long time and adore the art style. 
This Mod is my attempt to give the Stardew Valley characters portraits based on that art style.

I do have some things I would like to adjust here and there, but I'm the type who can make adjustments forever, so I decided to publish this mod as is and update later.

Feedback is welcome ^_^

I hope you all enjoy using these as much as I enjoyed creating them!
